description: Exercise the metric assertion (WA24): read the node's chain_head_block Prometheus metric once the chain has advanced. LIVE-VERIFIED 2026-09-11 on the 15-server docker fleet (4 bp, gstable 1.1.0). Restored once the three gaps that made it unusable were closed — the endpoint binds where the harness can reach it, the composition records a translated scrape URL per node, and a config-less launch says --metrics on the command line.
